steps.title: Add the send_mode setting
steps.what: Adds a send_mode config key with clipboard and pane values, defaulting to clipboard.
steps.why: Lets users pick between copying the prompt and choosing an agent pane.

steps.title: Use send_mode in the inbox
steps.what: The send buttons and prompt flow read send_mode and relabel themselves.
steps.why: Copying the prompt is safer than pasting into a pane by default.

steps.title: Cover both modes in the e2e test
steps.what: The checkout_scope script seeds send_mode and asserts the badge label.

steps.title: Document send_mode
steps.what: README describes the new key and its two values.
steps.why: Users need to know how to switch back to pane mode.
